Aisha (product): Quick thread: Customer Y asked for an auditor-friendly export flow + legal-hold semantics tied to SOC2/ISO evidence retention. Need draft launch checklist and any blockers.
Ben (eng-infra): Two main asks: (1) API for auditors to pull a signed evidence bundle, (2) retention enforcement that survives key rotations.
Sana (eng-security): For (1) we should issue a time-limited signed URL that references an immutable bundle stored in the evidence ledger. Bundle signed by our key + hash pointer to the audit ledger.
Priya (ops): Ops constraint: generating bundles on-demand at scale could spike IO. Suggest pre-generated nightly snapshots for enterprise tenants that opt into auditor access.
Noah (cs): Customers want a 'self-serve auditor access' setting in Console so they can invite 3rd-party auditors without opening a ticket. Also need audit trail of who granted access.
Lina (legal): From contracts perspective: need an addendum template that clarifies auditor privileges, approved export formats, and the chain-of-custody acceptance criteria. Draft language: "Redwood will provide tamper-evident audit bundles; customer-authorized auditors may retrieve bundles subject to access controls and retrieval SLAs."
Aisha (product): Proposed launch acceptance criteria:
- Auditor export API that returns a signed bundle (zip + manifest) with ledger hash pointer
- Console toggle to invite auditors + access audit events stored for 7y
- Legal-hold API that locks data across regions and overrides TTLs until release
- Evidence retrieval SLA (enterprise): <6h for manual release, <1h for automated escrow
- SOC2 preflight checklist passing in staging environment
Ben (eng-infra): Implementation note: we need to avoid double-encryption pitfalls during BYOK rotations. Plan: store bundles encrypted under a per-tenant symmetric data key (DEK). DEK wrapped by customer KEK or our escrow KEK. Rotation flow unwrap->rewrap without moving plaintext.
Sana (eng-security): Add: every KEK rotation must append a signed rotation event to ledger. Also include a nonce/version in bundle manifest so auditors can verify which key was used.
Priya (ops): Runbook idea for bundle generation:
- If tenant opted-in to nightly snapshots: generate at 02:00 UTC, push to immutable bucket, mark manifest with ledger hash
- On-demand auditor request: check hold-state, enqueue bundle-gen job, return signed pre-auth URL when complete
- If KEK rotation in progress and DEK rewrap backlog >1000, pause on-demand bundles and notify CS
Noah (cs): For customers, sample UX copy for Console: "Invite auditor -> grant scope (logs, exports, metadata) -> generate signed bundle -> auditor receives link valid 72h." Include cost estimates for on-demand bulk exports.
Lina (legal): Caveat language for SLAs: for air-gapped or manual escrow keys retrieval SLA may be "best-effort" and require joint coordination. Also require customer consent for auditor access in contracts.
Aisha (product): Gating checklist before GA:
- Gate A: Security audit pass for signed bundle format + manifest schema
- Gate B: Ops load test proving nightly snapshot pipeline at scale (10k tenants)
- Gate C: Legal signoff on contract addendum + sample consent flow
- Gate D: CS readiness: one-pager + support playbook
Ben (eng-infra): Quick sample manifest prototype:
```
{
  "tenant_id":"t-12345",
  "bundle_id":"b-20240501-0001",
  "created_at":"2024-05-01T02:01:12Z",
  "kek_version":"k-20240430-v2",
  "ledger_hash":"sha256:abcdef...",
  "files":["audit.log.gz","access-metadata.json"],
  "signatures":["redwood:sigsig...","customer:optional..."]
}
```
Sana (eng-security): Note: include a canonical verifier tool in our SDK so auditors can validate signatures + ledger inclusion proofs. We'll add that to the SDK backlog.
Priya (ops): Monitoring/alerts:
- Alert if snapshot pipeline lag > 10m
- Alert if bundle-gen queue > 500
- Alert if KEK replication delay > 120s
audit-bot: Automated note: SOC2-preflight check scheduled in staging on 2024-06-10 09:00 UTC.
Noah (cs): Action items: I'll draft the customer-facing flow + cost table. Priya -> ops runbook. Ben -> manifest + rewrap flow doc. Sana -> ledger proofs + SDK verifier. Lina -> contract addendum. Aisha -> coordinate SOC2 preflight.
Aisha (product): Thanks team. If anyone discovers an immovable blocker (regulatory or KMS limitation) call it out here. Otherwise we'll aim to present GA plan in next PM sync. :rocket:
